races.paceDynamic: Cinnabar Moth will take the field along as the confirmed front runner, but her tendency to fade means she's unlikely to sustain pressure if challenged. Ballyhahill, Nirisque, Chautuaqua, Cool Summer and Delorean Dynamite will settle prominently behind the leader creating a decent gallop through the early stages. The pace should be honest but not punishing, with the real action developing from the final hurdle as the prominent brigade comes under pressure and the hold-up horses like Crohan Lady and Evelyn get their chance to strike. This moderate pace favours prominent runners who can stay close enough to strike but avoid doing too much early work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cinnabar Moth sets a steady pace and the prominent horses can position perfectly
scenarios.body: The likes of Ballyhahill, Nirisque and Chautuaqua can use their tactical speed to kick from the last hurdle before the hold-up horses can get into gear. This honest gallop suits horses who can sit handy and have the class to quicken when required.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes ordinary and the race sets up for closers
scenarios.body: Crohan Lady and Evelyn will benefit from a steady tempo that allows them to conserve energy for their trademark late runs. The combination of soft ground and a moderate early pace will enable them to produce their best finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the three lightly-raced newcomers possess hidden ability
scenarios.body: Heatherhill Lady, Likeyouhaveplenty or Dromana Mist could have been working exceptionally well at home and spring a shock. The maiden nature of this contest means unexposed horses often outrun their odds when stepping up significantly in class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Cinnabar Moth Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Cinnabar Moth can overcome her finishing concerns and get an easy lead
scenarios.body: Her long absence could have refreshed her and if she can dictate terms from the front without pressure, she might just last home. However, her historical tendency to fade makes this the least likely outcome despite her front-running advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Kentucky Beach will take this field along as the sole natural front-runner, setting an honest but not punishing gallop on the soft ground. With no serious pace pressure expected, he can dictate terms and kick for home when ready, while the prominent runners like Polepatrick, Sea Eagle and Let's Go La Fichad will track him in the slipstream. The large field of hold-up horses including Euro Agent, Tyson Fury and Granlahan will need luck in running and a strong finish, but may struggle to peg back the leaders if they get first run. This race shape clearly favours front-running and prominent racing styles who can avoid traffic and capitalise on a controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kentucky Beach Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Kentucky Beach gets an uncontested lead and soft fractions
scenarios.body: He can dictate when to quicken and prove hard to peg back with his excellent course record on soft ground. The lack of pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move approaching the last.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes tactical and Kentucky Beach goes too slow
scenarios.body: The handy horses can get closer than ideal and have enough left to strike late when the leader's reserves are tested. Polepatrick or Sea Eagle can time their challenge perfectly from tracking positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The back-markers get their perfect scenario with a bunched field and furlong-long dash to the line. Tyson Fury's flat speed or Euro Agent's Elliott polish could prove decisive in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the established runners underperform and a newcomer emerges
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced horses like Cascando or Porcupine Bank could have significant untapped ability that maiden company exposes. Their connections suggest there's more to come than ratings indicate.

This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the modest early pace will leave plenty in reserve for a finishing sprint.

races.paceDynamic: King Of Westeros is the only confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner handicap hurdle and will be allowed to dictate terms from the front without pressure. The prominent runners like Maciver, Roccabaker, and Mullanour will likely sit just behind him in the early stages, but with 13 hold-up horses including Poppycon, Coffeys Forge, and Imarajan, the majority of the field will be held up for late challenges. This tactical setup creates a steady, uncontested pace early that will inevitably quicken from the home turn as the large contingent of hold-up horses make their moves. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver sustained finishing kicks in soft ground conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Westeros maintains an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady until the home turn.
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will have conserved energy and can unleash telling late challenges on the testing soft ground. Horses like Poppycon, Coffeys Forge, and Imarajan are perfectly positioned to benefit from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply more pressure on King Of Westeros and establish a stronger gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: Maciver and Roccabaker will be ideally placed to capitalize if they can get the pace to their liking and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Their positioning advantage becomes crucial if the race develops into a test of stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Westeros gets such an easy lead that he can still have enough left for the finish.
scenarios.body: With Jack Kennedy's tactical expertise and the lack of early pace pressure, King Of Westeros could steal a march and hold on despite his moderate recent form. The Gordon Elliott stable's 10/97 strike rate provides additional confidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexpected Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy affair with several horses making simultaneous moves.
scenarios.body: The large field and soft conditions could lead to traffic problems and a disjointed finish, allowing an outsider like Tedworth or Hob's Angel to capitalize on a good position and strong staying power. Chaos often favours horses carrying less weight.

races.paceDynamic: Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic will contest the early lead, with Mount Frisco likely to assert given his stronger recent form and tactical speed. With 7 prominent racers including Casey West, Sammy Smart, Aclass and General Clermont creating congestion behind the leaders, this sets up as a moderate to strong gallop with plenty of pressure from the off. The large field and soft ground will create a stamina test, particularly with traffic problems likely approaching the business end. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and finish strongly, with the pace battle up front setting it up perfectly for closers.

scenarios.body: His recent form suggests he has the class to wire the field if not pressured too early. Doyen Magic could also benefit if Mount Frisco weakens, inheriting a handy position to kick clear.

races.paceDynamic: Itsalonglongroad will take them along from the front at a steady tempo, with only Courtbrack Boy likely to press early from his prominent position. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the leader can dictate terms and set sensible fractions through the early stages. With eight hold-up horses sitting back waiting to pounce, this sets up a tactical affair where the kick timing becomes crucial. This pace scenario strongly favours front-running and prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Itsalonglongroad maintains a strong gallop turning for home without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The veteran can use his tactical advantage to build an unassailable lead while the pack of hold-up horses get in each other's way. His recent Goodwood win shows he retains the ability to lead all the way when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up turning in
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a sprint finish where class can tell over stamina. Cerberus and La Tene have shown recent promise and benefit from the tactical switch-off.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses are caught behind rivals in the straight
scenarios.body: The eight hold-up specialists create a bottleneck that favours those with clearest runs or already in forward positions. Prominent runners and those drawn favourably benefit most from the congestion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and testing conditions catch out some rivals late
scenarios.body: The combination of soft going and 1m7½f distance finds out those lacking genuine stamina reserves. Proven stayers with solid recent form hold sway as others fade.

watchPoints.text: L'Amiral Fromentin's tendency to fade in the finish combined with trainer's woeful 0/32 record makes him a complete avoid
Traffic problems inevitable with eight hold-up horses - those drawn wide or getting poor early positions face serious disadvantage
Itsalonglongroad's jumping under pressure after long absence - any mistake gifts race to closers
Courtbrack Boy's early positioning crucial as only serious challenger to the leader in forward positions
Ground conditions deteriorating through card - later runners may face even softer conditions than advertised
